articles.title: MANTRA token plunges 18% to record low as blockchain halts after exploit
articles.snippet: The token touched $0.004126 minutes before the network stopped producing blocks, while MANTRA later said an attacker exploited a vulnerability in software used by the chain.

articles.title: Elon Musk's X is exploring stablecoins to pay influencers and content providers
articles.snippet: Conversations with X are ongoing, according to a person who also works with other social media platforms testing stablecoins to pay influencers.

articles.title: CFTC chair says agency will move forward on crypto regulation if CLARITY fails
articles.snippet: Michael Selig said at a meeting of the Innovation Advisory Committee that he had directed CFTC staff to explore developer protections and other crypto-related policies.

articles.title: CFTC Chair Readies Crypto Rules If Congress Fails to Pass Clarity Act
articles.snippet: The CFTC chair said staff is already exploring a crypto market structure framework and could move quickly to propose rules if Congress fails to act.

articles.title: Six-Bug Exploit Halts Maya Protocol After $1.4 Million in Bitcoin Stolen
articles.snippet: The cross-chain protocol said an attacker exploited six software flaws to drain Bitcoin and other assets, sending its CACAO token plunging.
